text:
sara: FYI I hit a nasty dup problem while walking a new hire through the sampleapp demo. Token refresh + transient 429s caused invoice creation to run twice. Repro in staging with low token TTL.

tom: oh no. is the SDK replaying the original POST when it refreshes the token? that will cause duplicates if the server treats the request as non-idempotent.

sara: yup. sequence: client gets 401, refreshes credential, retries original POST. Some retries got 429 and then the client retried again after backoff, which ended up creating duplicates.

jules: we intentionally left automatic idempotency out of SDKs to avoid surprising behavior with caches and proxies. But sampleapp should show explicit idempotency usage.

ria: Agreed. For DX we could add a sample snippet that demonstrates adding an Idempotency-Key header and a short server-side dedupe example.

tom: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) add full-jitter backoff for 429s 2) add a small no-retry window after a token refresh (e.g., 300-500ms) 3) offer an opt-in auto-idempotency flag in SDKs that sets X-Redwood-Idemp.

sara: repro payload:```
POST /v1/create-invoice
Authorization: Bearer <short-lived-token>
{ "customer": "ACME", "amount": 4200 }
```
When token rotated mid-flight, the SDK retried the body.

jules: proposal: SDK config { autoIdempotency: false, idempotencyWindowMs: 2500 } When enabled, SDK attaches X-Redwood-Req-Id and tracks recent req ids in-memory to avoid replaying the same body within the window.

ria: +1 for opt-in defaulting to false for parity. Also add logging when dedupe prevents a retry so teams can understand behavior.

tom: also saw a stampede from parallel onboarding clients. We should cap concurrent retry bursts with a token-bucket per-process and jitter randomized per request. Defaults: baseDelay=150ms, maxDelay=1500ms, jitter=full.

deploy-bot: Note: staging incident logged 2026-03-18T02:41:03Z - 24 duplicate invoices created by onboarding script. Issue cleaned.

sara: another edge: if server dedupe is time-based and client clocks are skewed, dedupe TTL mismatch causes misses. Server-side should anchor TTL to arrival time and ignore client timestamps.

jules: operational plan: - add sampleapp changes to show explicit Idempotency-Key and the opt-in autoIdempotency flag - implement autoIdemp in node+py SDKs behind a flag + telemetry events - update docs with a token-rotation cookbook and recommended backoff settings - add a small test harness to CI that simulates token rotation + transient 429s

ria: can someone pick up the sampleapp PR? I'll add doc tasks to onboarding checklist and update the demo script.

tom: I'll prototype the in-SDK no-retry-after-refresh guard and the per-process retry cap.

jules: i'll add telemetry keys: dedupe.attempts, dedupe.hits, dedupe.misses so Console can show if customers rely on auto dedupe.

sara: thanks all. If we get the sampleapp showing best practice, new users won't accidentally hit this. :party-parrot: 

ria: follow-ups created: SAMP-201, DOC-512, SDK-1034, TELE-88
